notes: Paper (Table view_eval) reports indoor/outdoor/all averages only -> all 9 scenes. Official run_mip360.py: -r4 outdoor / -r2 indoor (PIL resize of full-res images; we use mipnerf360-pilr (full-res PIL -r 4 / -r 2, = official run_mip360.py) = mipnerf360 protocol), black background, --densify_abs_grad_threshold 0.0002, exposure off, 30k steps. Compare group averages and the gain over our gsplat baseline vs paper gain over 3DGS (indoor -0.63, outdoor +0.52 dB). The density controller reloads the training split from --data (bench.py passes it). First job JIT-compiles ss_pgsr_plane (~1 min, cached). Expect slower training than gsplat: from step 7001 every step renders a second (neighbour) view with plane outputs, and every 1000 steps < 15000 all training views are rendered for the observation trim. Official cap 6M Gaussians (max_all_points), so --max-gaussians 12M is never reached. Optional extra (not requested): pgsr-tnt (exposure on) has no locally runnable paper target; DTU Chamfer needs full-view DTU (not available locally).
